tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: The page ground. By day the pale mesh (surface-mesh-*) lies over it; at night it is near-black under the night sky. Content sits straight on it, grouped by space, never boxed. Code: --paper.

tokens.name: surface-mesh-lilac
tokens.usage: Two of the four soft blobs of the page mesh by day: top left and bottom right (gh-mesh). Each blob fades in six even steps to nothing, sized in px so no bands show (Robert, 20 Nov 2026: paler, so nothing reads as lines). Meta text keeps 6.2:1 on the deepest part. At night it equals the page and the night sky lies over it.

tokens.name: surface-mesh-blue
tokens.usage: The soft blue blob of the page mesh by day, top right (gh-mesh). Each blob fades in six even steps to nothing, sized in px so no bands show (Robert, 20 Nov 2026: paler, so nothing reads as lines). Meta text keeps 6.2:1 on the deepest part. At night it equals the page and the night sky lies over it.

tokens.name: surface-mesh-peach
tokens.usage: The soft peach blob of the page mesh by day, left of centre (gh-mesh). Each blob fades in six even steps to nothing, sized in px so no bands show (Robert, 20 Nov 2026: paler, so nothing reads as lines). Meta text keeps 6.2:1 on the deepest part. At night it equals the page and the night sky lies over it.

tokens.name: surface-solid
tokens.usage: Solid grounds: the top bar once the page scrolls, the bubble of the current page or choice, list rows that need a ground, tooltips and the comment count on a phone paragraph. Code: --surface.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet buttons, selected and unread rows (Notifications), the open comment count and the comment mark. Code: --tint.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Side panels opened on request: the editor's chapter list and plan, Atlas panels. Code: --panel.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: Everything that floats (the top bar, the phone header and tab bar, the chapter bar, chapter navigation, menus, sheets, panels and dialogs) plus ONE glass hero per page (Robert, 20 Nov 2026), always with backdrop blur 24px saturate 180% and the glass rim. Not on other content cards. Code: --surface-glass.

tokens.name: surface-glass-rim
tokens.usage: The 1px rim around glass. Code: --glass-border.

tokens.name: surface-field
tokens.usage: Text fields and the search pill, always with line-control. Code: --field.

tokens.name: paper-story
tokens.usage: Under story text in the reader and the editor. Plain: no grain under the words (proposal). Code: --story-paper.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Story text on paper-story (15.2:1 by day, 14.8:1 at night). Code: --story-ink.

tokens.name: ink-heading
tokens.usage: Headings, the wordmark and line 1 of a two-line headline (Revolver). Reads on every surface and on paper-story. Code: --heading.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Interface text on every surface and on paper-story. Code: --ink.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines, captions, times, and a subline only when it adds a fact. 7:1 or more on surface-page by day, 11:1 at night. Code: --body.

tokens.name: ink-accent
tokens.usage: Line 2 of a two-line headline (violet by day) and a paragraph's comment count. Never body copy. Code: --accent.

tokens.name: ink-link
tokens.usage: Links. Underlined in running text, so colour is never the only cue. Code: --link.

tokens.name: ink-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and their warnings, never decoration. Code: --destructive.

tokens.name: ink-kicker
tokens.usage: The one page kicker, black by day and white at night, never gold (Robert, 7 Nov 2026). Code: --eyebrow.

tokens.name: action-main
tokens.usage: The ONE main action per screen (button-main): a flat fill, plum #48125D by day (the code's --primary; Robert's pick of 20 Nov 2026, replacing Revolver #2A0E33) and cobalt at night. No rim, sheen or coloured shadow. At night the cobalt is 2.2:1 on the page; the white label (8.4:1) carries the button, as WCAG 1.4.11 allows for a button named by its text. Code: --plum-to and --plum-from, which become the same value.

tokens.name: action-main-hover
tokens.usage: Main action on hover and press: violet by day (Robert, 11 Nov 2026), a lighter cobalt at night. Flat. Code: --plum-hover-to and --plum-hover-from, which become the same value.

tokens.name: on-action-main
tokens.usage: Label and icon on action-main and action-main-hover: 12.9:1 on plum and 8.9:1 on violet by day; 8.4:1 on cobalt and 5.9:1 on hover at night. Code: --on-plum.

tokens.name: action-selected
tokens.usage: A chip, tab or segment that is on; filled progress inside controls. By day the same plum as the main button: they never do the same job, and a chip that is on also shows a check. Code: --primary, --chip-on.

tokens.name: on-action-selected
tokens.usage: Label on action-selected. Code: --on-primary.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers between groups, used rarely: space separates first. Never the only mark of a control. Code: --border.

tokens.name: line-hairline
tokens.usage: The 1px rule between rows of a label and value list. Code: --hairline.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of fields, chips and drop-downs: 3:1 or more on surface-page and surface-solid in both themes. Code: --control-border.

tokens.name: line-dashed
tokens.usage: Dashed outlines of empty places: the free places on a bookshelf, drop zones. Decorative; the count is always written too. Code: --dashed-border.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring, drawn outside a 2px gap of focus-halo, on every control. Code: --focus-ring.

tokens.name: focus-halo
tokens.usage: The gap between a control and its focus ring, so the ring reads on any fill. Code: --focus-halo.

tokens.name: thread
tokens.usage: The one thread (proposal): a 2px line for progress under covers on Continue reading, the current tab, the unread row in Notifications, the current chapter dot, the line of a line chart and the tint of an open paragraph. Violet by day; white at night.

tokens.name: logo
tokens.usage: The cat and the wordmark: Revolver by day, soft white at night. Other looks swap it for their accent. Code: --logo.

tokens.name: cover-plum
tokens.usage: Drawn and automatic covers. Covers keep their colours in both themes. Code: coverPalette.plum.

tokens.name: cover-ink
tokens.usage: Drawn covers; also the dark title colour on light cover grounds. Code: coverPalette.ink.

tokens.name: cover-violet
tokens.usage: Drawn covers. Code: coverPalette.violet.

tokens.name: cover-gold
tokens.usage: Drawn covers. Code: coverPalette.gold.

tokens.name: cover-lilac
tokens.usage: Drawn covers. Code: coverPalette.lilac.

tokens.name: cover-blush
tokens.usage: Drawn covers. Code: coverPalette.blush.

tokens.name: cover-sky
tokens.usage: Drawn covers. Code: coverPalette.sky.

tokens.name: cover-sage
tokens.usage: Drawn covers. Code: coverPalette.sage.

tokens.name: cover-paper
tokens.usage: Drawn covers, and the paper label every Label cover carries, picture covers included (proposal). Code: coverPalette.paper.

tokens.name: state-info-fill
tokens.usage: Info notices. Code: --info-bg.

tokens.name: state-info-line
tokens.usage: Border of info notices. Code: --info-border.

tokens.name: state-info-ink
tokens.usage: Text on state-info-fill. Code: --info-text.

tokens.name: state-success-fill
tokens.usage: Success notices. Code: --success-bg.

tokens.name: state-success-line
tokens.usage: Border of success notices. Code: --success-border.

tokens.name: state-success-ink
tokens.usage: Text on state-success-fill. Code: --success-text.

tokens.name: state-warning-fill
tokens.usage: Warning notices. Code: --warning-bg.

tokens.name: state-warning-line
tokens.usage: Border of warning notices. Code: --warning-border.

tokens.name: state-warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text on state-warning-fill, and a deadline in a meta line (Due tomorrow) on any ground: 7.1:1 on the page by day, 12.6:1 at night. Code: --warning-text.

tokens.name: state-danger-fill
tokens.usage: Urgent safety notices and errors only. Code: --error-bg.

tokens.name: state-danger-line
tokens.usage: Border for errors. Code: --error-border.

tokens.name: state-danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text on state-danger-fill. Code: --error-text.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Funnel Display, two weights: 600 for sections, 700 for titles.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the page title of Home, Read, Library, Write and Together on wide screens. Phones use title. A two-line headline sets line 1 in ink-heading and line 2 in ink-accent.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A story's title on its page, a chapter's title in the reader, page titles on phones.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings: a row's name on Read, the sections of Home and Write. No eyebrow above it.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Card titles, a bookshelf's name, sheet and dialog titles.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Inter: 400 and 600; the page kicker keeps Inter Bold as decided on 7 Nov 2026.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Mara commented on a paragraph in chapter 8.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, the name at the top of a comment.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Meta lines joined by middots, captions, counts, times. Replaces most pills.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: At most one per page, only when it carries a fact the heading does not. Capitals come from CSS; locale text stays in sentence case. Colour ink-kicker.

groups.name: Reading
groups.note: Literata for story text; OpenDyslexic and Atkinson Hyperlegible when a reader picks them in Aa.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: The lamp had burned all night, and still the ship did not come.
styles.usage: Story text in the reader and the editor: the default size, which readers change in Aa. One column of about 65 characters (measure), paper-ink on paper-story.

styles.name: reading-dyslexia
styles.sample: The lamp had burned all night, and still the ship did not come.
styles.usage: Story text when a reader picks OpenDyslexic in Aa: the reading size and line height, with 0.04em letter spacing as in the app.

styles.name: reading-hyperlegible
styles.sample: The lamp had burned all night, and still the ship did not come.
styles.usage: Story text when a reader picks Atkinson Hyperlegible in Aa, made so letters that look alike (I, l, 1; O, 0) are easy to tell apart.

groups.name: Hand
groups.note: Playwrite Cuba, for handwritten accents only.

styles.name: hand
styles.sample: for Lia, who read it first
styles.usage: A handwritten accent: a dedication, a certificate signature line. Never interface text, never more than one line on a screen.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: An icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: A heading and its meta line; gaps between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside list rows; between a heading and the row arrows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The phone side gutter; card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on wide screens; between blocks inside a section; between covers in a row on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: The side gutter at 1440 px and wider.

tokens.name: radius-book
tokens.usage: Every book cover, at every size: a cover is a book, not an app tile (proposal; today 16px).

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Text fields, menu rows, small tiles, swatches in the Aa sheet.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs, side panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the top bar, the tab bar, the chapter bar and chapter navigation, the time-left pill, comment counts, avatars.

shadow.note: Two shadows only. Glass adds its own 1px rim and blur; nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-rest
tokens.usage: The bubble that marks the current page or choice, and the comment count on a phone paragraph. Code: --shadow-card.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Everything glass (the floating layer and the one hero per page) and tooltips. Code: --shadow-popover.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: The smallest touch target for anything pressable.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields and drop-downs.

tokens.name: chip-height
tokens.usage: Filter chips (inside a 44px target).

tokens.name: topbar-max
tokens.usage: The widest the top bar and the content column get.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: The reading column: about 65 characters of reading text.

meta.note: Colours copied from code, except the main button by day: flat plum #48125D (the code's --primary), Robert's pick of 20 Nov 2026. Thread, type scale, spacing, radii and sizes are the DESIGN proposal of 20 Nov 2026, awaiting Robert's approval.
